proposition: The letters show friendly contact with Shāh Niʿmat Allāh Valī, Qāsim-i Anvār, Aḥmad Samarqandī, Ḥasan ʿAṭṭār and Sayyid Muḥammad b. Shaykh Kajujī; MK says this corroborates the apologies' account of his (mainly admonitory) dealings with Sufi shaykhs and counterbalances his criticism of organized Sufism.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to Sufi shaykhs
mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
